defs.def: the thick main stem of a tree, that the branches grow from 树干

ex.s: Then, with one end of a rope tied to his waist and the other end around the trunk of a tree, Ziyad began ____47____ .
ex.t: 然后，齐亚德把绳子的一端系在腰上，另一端绕在树干上，开始____47____。

ex.s: He stopped every few minutes to move the ____48____ higher up the tree trunk.
ex.t: 他每隔几分钟停下来把____48____往树干更高处移动。

ex.s: The force required to break the pancake was less than 1% of the trunk’s weight (about 100kg).
ex.t: 掰开那块“煎饼”所需的力小于树干重量（约100公斤）的1%。

ex.s: I was running so fast that I bounced off the trunk and  40   on my backside.
ex.t: 我跑得这么快 就从后备箱里跳了出来 背上还有40个

ex.s: Before the heavy lifting began, the team assessed the root system and dug a five-foot-deep cylinder , measuring 40 feet in diameter, around the trunk to protect all essential roots.
ex.t: 在重型吊装开始前，团队先评估了根系，并在树干周围挖了一个深五英尺、直径40英尺的圆柱形坑，以保护所有重要的根部。

ex.s: The little plum tree outside, with the faintly flushed snow lining its branches and artfully disposed along its trunk, stood in full sunlight.
ex.t: 窗外那棵小李子树，枝条上淡淡地衬着浅红的积雪，精心点缀着树干，傲然挺立在灿烂的阳光下。

ex.s: Now the trunks of trees on the bottom, and the old log canoe, and the dark surrounding woods, are gone, and the villagers, who scarcely know where it lies, instead of going to the pond to bathe or drink, are thinking to bring its water...
ex.t: 如今水底树干、旧木独木舟和四周幽暗的树林都已不在，村民们几乎不知池塘所在，不再去池边沐浴饮水，反倒想着引来它的水……

ex.s: The Waka is a traditional canoe that has been skillfully carved out of a tree trunk, with beautiful carvings added to show tribal history and culture.
ex.t: 瓦卡号是一款传统的独木舟,由树干巧妙地雕刻而成,加上了美丽的雕刻,以展示部落历史和文化.

ex.s: The elephant’s nose, or trunk, is also used to make noises and to welcome other elephants.
ex.t: 大象的鼻子或树干也被用来制造噪音和欢迎其他大象.

ex.s: If an elephant spreads its ears, it means “Watch out!” To show friendship, elephants will touch each other with their trunks and stand close to each other, putting their heads together.
ex.t: 如果一头大象散开耳朵,意思是“小心!”为了显示友谊,大象会用树干互相摸摸,并站在一起,把头放在一起。

the long nose of an elephant 象鼻

ex.s: The elephant was found to either use suction at a fixed distance from the pancake to "raise” the object in the air and hold it, or gently press the tip of its trunk against the pancake and apply suction to pick it up.
ex.t: 研究发现，大象要么在离煎饼固定距离处使用吸力把物体抬到空中并吸住，要么轻轻把象鼻尖压在煎饼上施加吸力把它捡起。

ex.t: 关于大象鼻子在实验中的情况可以了解到什么？
